Buying guide and item details

PUBG Mobile × Bentley 2026 event: dates, models and finishes

The PUBG Mobile × Bentley collaboration runs from November 20, 2026 to January 12, 2027. The current event announcement names the Bentayga Azure SUV, Continental GTC Mulliner convertible and Flying Spur Mulliner sedan. Digital Racer is an independent marketplace, not an official PUBG Mobile or Bentley partner; a third-party listing is not a guarantee of publisher-authorized transfer.

Some Digital Racer listings also mention Bentley Batur designs or other seller-described vehicle finishes. Do not assume every historical Bentley finish is available through the 2026 event or that a car card unlocks every model shown in a promotional image. Compare the exact item name and finish against the current in-game offering.

For international enquiries, compare the pictured model and finish with the in-game selection, check whether the offer is a card, a gift or an already owned skin, and confirm server eligibility, any friendship waiting period, final USD charge and payment fees. Never share passwords, recovery codes or one-time security codes.

Start with the exact vehicle and finish

A sports-car brand alone does not uniquely identify a cosmetic. PUBG Mobile collaborations can feature particular models, finishes and color variants. Compare the full item name shown in the game, not only a photo of a luxury-car logo or the label one car card. Different finishes are not automatically interchangeable, and visual appearance does not guarantee a gameplay advantage.

If a listing references an upgraded or special-edition finish, the level or variant should be explicitly identified. Do not assume a card unlocks every option illustrated in an event promotion.

Check whether the item can be sent or redeemed

Event cards, gift tokens and ownership unlocks are not the same thing. Gifting features can have friend-history requirements, account or region restrictions and time limits. The active in-game event description is the correct authority for whether a particular item can be gifted or redeemed. A screenshot saying instant delivery is not proof that the game currently permits that transaction.

If an offer mentions a waiting period or friend request, confirm what happens during the waiting period and whether the item remains obtainable at the end of it. Never share login passwords or recovery codes to receive a cosmetic.

Understand regional and price differences

Prices here are displayed in USD to give international visitors a consistent reference. However, actual payment options, conversion charges, availability and regional server eligibility may differ. Verify the exact full amount before paying. A card price should be assessed against the specified finish and event conditions, not against an unrelated old social-media screenshot.

Do not infer that every vehicle cosmetic can be sold or transferred under publisher rules. PUBG Mobile restricts virtual-item transactions except where permitted by its instructions.
